title: PIDSS Recommendation Schema
description: Output schema for the Python Analytics CLI (Pidss.Analytics). Written to artifacts/{run_id}/recommendation.json. Contains ranked, explainable recommendations with quantified ROI, payback, and linked failure modes.

recommendations.description: Ranked list of recommendations. Index 0 is highest priority. May be empty if no actionable recommendations.

target_stage_ids.description: stage_ids to which this recommendation applies. May be empty for factory-level recommendations.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why this recommendation was generated, referencing detected failure modes and KPI evidence.

linked_failure_modes.description: Failure mode codes that triggered or are addressed by this recommendation.

confidence.description: rule_based in Phase 6. ml_model in Phase 9 after ML decision intelligence is introduced.

EstimatedImpact.description: Quantified impact estimates for this recommendation. All fields are optional — not all recommendations have full financial projections.

throughput_delta.description: Expected throughput change in units/hr. Positive = improvement.

throughput_delta_percent.description: Throughput delta as a percentage of baseline throughput.

lead_time_delta.description: Expected lead time change in hours. Negative = improvement.

footprint_delta.description: Expected footprint change in m2. Negative = reduction.

capex_usd.description: Estimated capital expenditure required to implement this recommendation.

opex_delta_usd_per_year.description: Expected change in annual operational cost. Negative = cost reduction.

reliability_improvement.description: Expected improvement in effective_availability if recommendation involves reliability upgrade.
